representation_fit.evidence: Primary representation is exactly the brief's shape: a single sequential high-consequence runbook — 4 phases / 13 steps with per-step verification checks, evidence fields and decision gates (source/data.js:15-350), irreversible steps flagged in the rail with red dots (1280x860 screenshot, steps 7-9), hard sequential gating in gate() (source/app.js:64-78) and a completion verdict literally named '零失误走完全程' (source/app.js:300) matching the brief's success standard.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen is dominated by the current step's work card ('1. 成立应急响应' with action list, 3 checks, evidence inputs, gate hint '门禁未通过·还差: 检查项 0/3…' — 1280x860 and 1440x900 screenshots; source/app.js:257-294), with the full 13-step map in the left rail. Deduction: the whole surface is dimmed by a stray overlay and the right ~400px is covered by a stray audit drawer that clips the 切换指挥 input (both screenshots), weakening effective salience at first paint.

time_to_understand.evidence: What/where is conveyed fast: header title + incident code (source/index.html:21-22), highlighted current step with phase tags (screenshots), explicit gate hint naming what is missing. But two phantom surfaces confuse first reading: a ~55% black full-viewport dim (styles.css:472) and an unexplained red horizontal sliver at the exact viewport center (y≈430/860 and y≈450/900 in the two screenshots) — an empty #modal rendered because .modal-overlay's display:grid (styles.css:473) overrides the hidden attribute (source/index.html:56).

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object (current step) is on screen at load with zero navigation; rail buttons give one-click read-only return to any completed step while future steps are disabled by the sequential gate by design (source/app.js:119-127, 574-578); '返回当前步骤' restores context (source/app.js:274).

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions are in-page: the irreversible confirmation modal restates step, phase, consequence and recovery path in place (source/app.js:378-393); the gate hint/action bar updates incrementally without re-rendering inputs to preserve focus (source/app.js:495-529); recovery can even be fired from the read-only review view (source/app.js:154).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Intended permanent surfaces (header status, step rail + legend, step card, action bar, on-demand drawer/modal) are all justified by the job. But two surfaces that should be hidden are permanently visible due to the display/hidden conflict — .audit-drawer display:flex (styles.css:534) vs hidden (source/index.html:61; toggle at source/app.js:366 is visually inert) and .modal-overlay display:grid (styles.css:473) vs hidden (source/index.html:56) — adding an always-open empty drawer and a dead-center modal sliver that the user did not ask for.

accessibility.evidence: All three a11y receipt checks failed: a11y.contrast fail, a11y.focus_order fail, a11y.target_size fail (measurement-summary.json). Corroborated in source/UI: the stray fixed overlay (z-index 50, styles.css:469-477) covers the viewport at load and, being a rendered element over everything, would intercept pointer input and pollutes tab order together with the always-rendered drawer's 关闭 button; intrinsic low-contrast tokens (--ink-3 #8593a8 on white, styles.css:8) for legend/hints; 17px checkboxes (styles.css:287-288) below common 24px target minimum. Only :focus-visible outlining (styles.css:37-41) and native controls are positives.

frontend_rework.evidence: Visible layout defects on the initial screen in both viewports: (1) full-page dim from the never-hidden .modal-overlay; (2) the empty-modal red sliver exactly centered (width ≈620px = .modal max-width, styles.css:483; border-top 5px solid --danger, styles.css:486) spanning x≈330-950 at 1280 wide; (3) the phantom drawer overlapping/clipping the 切换指挥 field (both screenshots). Receipt implies rework: layout.overflow fail, layout.responsive_collision fail, plus the three a11y fails — 5 of 7 checks failed with target_invalid:false (measurement-summary.json). Root fix requires reconciling [hidden] with author display rules in styles.css:473/534.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '不可逆步骤有恢复/确认路径' is covered twice over in source and validated behavior: each irreversible step (s7/s8/s9, data.js:157-252) carries a confirmWord (FENCE/PROMOTE/CUTOVER) enforced in a confirmation ritual modal with ack + typed word (source/app.js:378-393, 425-440), AND a recovery path panel rendered before execution (source/app.js:285-289) with trigger conditions, steps, impact, window gating ('恢复窗口已关闭' source/app.js:167) and a two-stage arm/fire trigger that logs a deviation and rolls the step back (source/app.js:481-493). validate.mjs exercises wrong-word rejection, recovery rollback and zero-deviation completion (source/scripts/validate.mjs:238-348).

defects_observed: Author display rules defeat the hidden attribute: .modal-overlay { display:grid } (styles.css:473) and .audit-drawer { display:flex } (styles.css:534) override [hidden] (index.html:56,61; toggles at app.js:366,414 are visually inert), so both overlays render permanently.

Initial screen is dimmed by a full-viewport rgba(13,18,27,.55) overlay in both screenshots; as a rendered z-index:50 fixed element it also sits above every control, so pointer interaction is structurally blocked at load (keyboard/Escape paths remain).

Empty #modal renders as a ~620px red horizontal sliver at the exact viewport center (y≈430 in 1280x860, y≈450 in 1440x900; x≈330-950 at 1280 wide) — visible in both screenshots as the unexplained red line.
Audit drawer is permanently open at 400px, overlapping the work region and clipping the 切换指挥 evidence input in both screenshots; receipt layout.responsive_collision and layout.overflow fail.

a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order and a11y.target_size all fail per receipt (measurement-summary.json); consistent with the dimming overlay, stray focusable drawer controls, 17px checkboxes and low-contrast #8593a8 hint text.
scores.overall_note: Conceptually this is the strongest possible match to the brief: a single 13-step, 4-phase database failover runbook with hard sequential gating (checks + format-validated evidence + decision required before each release), a three-word confirmation ritual and windowed recovery paths for every irreversible step, an audit trail with deviation accounting, and inline data so the first screen is ready with no loading state — the acceptance seed (irreversible steps have confirm/recover paths) is explicitly implemented and self-tested in scripts/validate.mjs. However, one CSS cascade defect dominates everything a user actually sees: because .modal-overlay and .audit-drawer declare display:grid/flex, the hidden attribute on both (index.html:56,61) is defeated, so the initial page loads permanently dimmed by a 55% black overlay, with an empty modal's 5px red border showing as a phantom line at the exact viewport center, and with a permanently-open empty audit drawer clipping the evidence fields — matching both operator screenshots and explaining the receipt's 5/7 failures (layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, and all three a11y checks; target_invalid:false). The workflow machinery underneath is excellent, but the delivered initial surface is visibly broken and pointer-hostile, which is what the defect-facing dimensions score against. Model-judged proxies only; task_completion_time, information_retrieval_accuracy and human_preference are not observable in this blind pilot.
